heading: Friday, November 1, 2024
topLine: PatternBoost finds counterexample to a 30-year-old hypercube conjecture.

items.headline: PatternBoost finds counterexample to a 30-year-old hypercube conjecture
items.summary: François Charton, Jordan Ellenberg, Adam Zsolt Wagner and Geordie Williamson introduced PatternBoost. It alternates classical local search with a transformer trained on the best constructions found so far. Among other results, it found a spanning subgraph of the 6-cube with diameter 6 and 81 edges, one fewer than the standard construction that Graham had conjectured was optimal. This disproves a conjecture that had been open for about 30 years. The counterexample is an explicit graph that can be checked directly; the paper is an arXiv preprint.

image.alt: Spanning subgraph of the 6-cube with diameter 6 and 81 edges, the counterexample found by PatternBoost
